en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad Bin Isa, from Rabi’e Bin Abdullah, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘It was so that Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> would greet (السَّلَامُ) upon the women and they were returning the greeting upon him<sup>saww</sup>; and it was so that Amir Al Momineen<sup>asws</sup> would greet (السَّلَامُ) upon the women, and he<sup>asws</sup> used to dislike greeting (السَّلَامُ) upon the young ones from them, and he<sup>asws</sup> was saying (it is so that): ‘One should be afraid that her voice might astound him, so what would enter upon him would be more than what he is seeking from the Recompense’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from Hammad ibn ‘Isa from Rib’i ibn ‘Abd Allah from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “

The Messenger of Allah would offer greeting of peace to women and they would respond to him. Amir al-Mu’ minin, Ali ibn abu Talib (a.s.) would offer greeting of peace to women but he disliked offering it to the young women. He would say, ‘I fear their voice may attract me and a feeling may cause me more harm than the reward for offering the greeting of peace.’”
